clauses.statement: A passing verification record whose command names a repo-relative test file path (node --test, npm/pnpm/yarn/bun test with explicit paths, npx vitest/jest/playwright with explicit paths) must be rejected when any named path does not exist in the repository, and the error must name every missing path; the evidence file must not be written on rejection.
clauses.rationale: node --test <missing-file> prints 'Could not find' and exits 0, so without deterministic path resolution a passing record credits coverage that never executed, as happened with test/pr-manager.test.js during story-vibepro-owner-gated-budget-override closure.

clauses.statement: The guard is deterministic and scoped: it resolves only unquoted-flag positional arguments matching test file extensions (.test/.spec .js/.ts/.jsx/.tsx/.cjs/.mjs) inside the repository; glob patterns, value-taking flag values such as --test-name-pattern, URL-like tokens, paths escaping the repo root, non-pass statuses, and commands that name no test paths are never rejected by it.
clauses.rationale: The guard must not parse runner output or guess; over-matching would reject legitimate evidence (npm test, globs, name patterns) and break every existing recording path.

clauses.statement: Given a repository where test/delivery-efficiency-guardrail.test.js exists and test/pr-manager.test.js does not, when a passing unit record is submitted with command 'node --test test/delivery-efficiency-guardrail.test.js test/pr-manager.test.js', then recording fails with an error naming test/pr-manager.test.js (and not the existing file), and verification-evidence.json is not created; the same command with only existing paths is accepted.

inherited_behavior.condition: kind/command compatibility (assertCommandMatchesVerificationKind), artifact cross-check contradictions, and shell-substitution rejection behave as before; verify run additionally rejects such commands pre-flight before executing them

clauses.rationale: This reproduces the exact incident: a multi-file node --test command where one named file was missing was accepted as passing evidence and credited pr-manager coverage in the gate DAG.
